courses.name: Functional Anatomy
courses.courseContribution: Direct anatomical systems and medical-image interpretation foundation; no clinical qualification or full biomechanical mechanics sequence.

courses.name: Human Physiology
courses.courseContribution: Direct organ-system homeostasis and physiological regulation; no instrumentation or clinical-care placement equivalence.

courses.name: Mechanisms of Disease
courses.courseContribution: Direct disease mechanisms and case-based diagnostic reasoning; not the complete technical diagnosis/therapy curriculum.

courses.name: Pharmacology
courses.courseContribution: Direct molecular drug action, kinetics and therapeutic mechanisms; complementary to technology-supported treatment, not radiotherapy training.

courses.name: Neurobiology
courses.courseContribution: Direct nervous-system and behavioural physiology, literature and lab introduction; not a complete EEG/EMG or clinical neurotechnology sequence.

courses.name: Life Science Laboratory
courses.courseContribution: Direct biochemical/molecular experimental practice, blood analysis and bioinformatics introduction; no patient placement or clinical safety certification.

courses.name: Molecular Pathology & Genetics
courses.courseContribution: Direct molecular disease/genetics, diagnostic technologies and research-proposal method; not organ-system engineering as a whole.

courses.name: Introduction to Programming
courses.courseContribution: Direct Python computational problem-solving for later data/image methods; generic coding alone does not establish clinical technology.

courses.name: Mathematical Methods
courses.courseContribution: Direct calculus and differential-equation modelling foundation; no assumption that its project is physiological.

courses.name: Linear Algebra
courses.courseContribution: Direct matrices, least squares, eigenanalysis and signals-related linear methods; no medical-imaging physics inferred.

courses.name: Linear Systems
courses.courseContribution: Direct signals, frequency representations, filtering and feedback methods, genuinely relevant to the target signals strand; project is not presumed clinical.

courses.name: Machine Learning
courses.courseContribution: Direct statistical prediction/classification methods relevant to biomedical data; no medical domain or safety validation assumed.

courses.name: Image Processing & Computer Vision
courses.courseContribution: Direct filtering, segmentation, image features and recognition pipelines; target medical-image-processing strand is a genuine methods link, not MRI/CT instrument equivalence.

courses.name: Robotics
courses.courseContribution: Direct kinematics, manipulation and sensing/control introduction; complementary to technical device/biomechanical analysis, not surgical robotics qualification.

courses.name: Consumer Product Design
courses.courseContribution: Complementary needs/specifications/concept selection/prototyping and product environmental impact; actual consumer-product context is preserved, not relabelled medical-device clinical validation.

courses.name: Life Cycle Analysis & Circular Economy
courses.courseContribution: Complementary life-cycle environmental/social/health assessment for the limited planetary-health connection; no specialist medical-device or clinical-technology content invented.
